name: Identity and Access Management
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)

beginner.summary: For IT administrators, security analysts and developers who are starting with identity and access management. Covers identities, authentication and authorisation, lab tenants in Entra ID and Okta, MFA and passkeys, directories, SAML single sign-on, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, access control models, joiner-mover-leaver processes, SCIM provisioning, Conditional Access, Entra ID and Okta administration, privileged access, identity governance, customer identity, cloud IAM roles, machine identities, identity monitoring and sign-in troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Comfortable with Windows or Linux administration basics
Knows what users, groups and permissions are
Has used a web browser's developer tools or is willing to learn
outcomes: Explain authentication, authorisation and the identity lifecycle
Set up SSO with SAML and OIDC, MFA, passkeys and SCIM provisioning in Entra ID and Okta
Apply least privilege with RBAC, Conditional Access, privileged access and access reviews
Monitor identity activity and troubleshoot sign-in problems

days.topic: IAM Overview: Identities, Authentication, Authorisation and Lifecycle
subtopics: What an identity is: people, devices, services and agents
Access management, governance and privileged access
Identity as the new security perimeter
Certifications such as SC-300 and CIDPRO
Course project overview: identity for a 2,000-person company
days.lab_task: Map the identities, applications and access needs of the course company, mark the sources of truth and list its top five identity risks.
checks: Identities and applications are listed with owners
Each identity type has a source of truth
Five identity risks are ranked with reasons

days.topic: Lab Setup: Entra ID and Okta Developer Tenants, Test Users and Apps
subtopics: Creating a Microsoft Entra ID test tenant
Creating an Okta Integrator or developer org
days.lab_task: Create an Entra ID tenant and an Okta org, add test users and groups, create break-glass admin accounts and register two sample applications.
days.deliverable: Ready lab tenants with users and apps
checks: Both tenants have test users and groups
Break-glass accounts exist and are excluded from risky policies

days.topic: Authentication Methods: Passwords, MFA, Passkeys and FIDO2
days.lab_task: Turn on phishing-resistant MFA for admins and passkeys for staff, enable self-service password reset and test sign-in with each method.

days.topic: Directories: Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP and Cloud Directories
subtopics: Active Directory domains, forests and organisational units
Microsoft Entra ID as a cloud directory
days.lab_task: Build a small Active Directory with organisational units and groups, sync it to Entra ID, and map attributes into Okta Universal Directory.
checks: Users and groups exist in Active Directory
Users appear in Entra ID with correct attributes

days.topic: Single Sign-On with SAML 2.0
subtopics: Identity provider and service provider roles
days.lab_task: Connect a sample application to Entra ID and to Okta with SAML, map attributes, trace an assertion and fix a seeded certificate error.
days.deliverable: Working SAML SSO with a trace
checks: Users sign in through each identity provider
The application receives the right attributes

days.topic: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for Applications
subtopics: ID tokens, access tokens and refresh tokens
days.lab_task: Register an OIDC web app with authorisation code and PKCE, a service with client credentials, inspect the tokens and validate them in code.
days.deliverable: OIDC and OAuth integrations with token checks
checks: Users sign in to the web app with OIDC
The service gets a token with client credentials
Tokens are validated for issuer, audience and expiry

days.topic: Access Control Models: RBAC, ABAC and Least Privilege
subtopics: Designing roles for the course company
days.lab_task: Design roles for three departments, assign app access through groups, add one attribute-based rule and check that nobody has more access than needed.
checks: Access flows through groups and roles
No user has access beyond their role

days.topic: Identity Lifecycle: Joiner, Mover and Leaver Processes
subtopics: HR as the source of truth
days.lab_task: Build joiner, mover and leaver workflows from HR test data, run each case and find orphaned accounts left from earlier leavers.
checks: A joiner gets access on day one
A mover loses old access and gains new
A leaver loses all access the same day

days.topic: User Provisioning with SCIM and HR-Driven Provisioning
subtopics: Provisioning from Entra ID and Okta to apps
days.lab_task: Provision users and groups to a SCIM test app from Entra ID and from Okta, change attributes, deprovision a user and read the logs.
checks: Users and groups appear in the app
Attribute changes flow to the app
The deprovisioned user is disabled in the app

days.topic: Conditional Access and Risk-Based Authentication
subtopics: Signals: user, device, location, app and risk
days.lab_task: Create policies that require MFA off the corporate network, block legacy authentication and require compliant devices for admin portals, test them in report-only mode and enforce them.
days.deliverable: Conditional Access policies with test results
checks: Report-only results show the expected impact

days.topic: Microsoft Entra ID Administration
days.lab_task: Create dynamic groups, scope an admin to an administrative unit, invite a guest with an access package and run a Graph PowerShell report of app sign-ins.
days.deliverable: Entra ID configuration with a Graph report
checks: Dynamic groups have the expected members
The scoped admin manages only their unit
The Graph report lists app sign-ins

days.topic: Okta Workforce Identity Administration
days.lab_task: Configure group rules, an app integration with SSO and provisioning, an authentication policy and a workflow that notifies a manager when access is granted.
checks: The app uses SSO and provisioning
The workflow sends the manager notice

days.topic: Privileged Access Management: Vaults, Sessions and Just-in-Time Access
subtopics: Privileged Identity Management in Entra ID
Standing privilege and how to remove it
days.lab_task: Make an admin role eligible with approval in Privileged Identity Management, vault a server password with rotation and record a privileged session.
checks: Admin rights need activation and approval
The vaulted password rotates after use

days.topic: Identity Governance: Access Reviews, Certifications and Separation of Duties
days.lab_task: Run an access review of a finance app with managers as reviewers, remove denied access automatically and add a separation of duties rule for access requests.
days.deliverable: Completed access review and SoD rule

days.topic: Customer Identity (CIAM): Registration, Social Login and Consent
tools: Microsoft Entra External ID or Okta Customer Identity
days.lab_task: Set up customer sign-up with email verification, social login and passkeys for a sample app, record consent and brand the login page.
checks: Customers sign up and verify email

days.topic: Cloud IAM: Roles and Policies in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
subtopics: AWS IAM users, roles and policies
Google Cloud IAM roles and bindings
Federation from the workforce identity provider
days.lab_task: Federate one cloud account from Entra ID or Okta, assign least-privilege roles to two groups and use a policy analysis tool to find excessive permissions.
days.deliverable: Federated cloud access with a permission review
checks: Users sign in to the cloud with the corporate identity
Excessive permissions are found and removed

days.topic: Service Accounts, API Keys and Machine Identities
days.lab_task: Inventory machine identities in the lab, replace a hard-coded API key with a managed identity, rotate a secret and alert on expiring certificates.
checks: Service accounts, keys and certificates are listed
The application uses a managed identity

days.topic: Identity Logs, Monitoring and Identity Threats
subtopics: Sending identity logs to a SIEM
days.lab_task: Send identity logs to a SIEM, detect a seeded password spray and MFA fatigue attack, and alert on a new global admin assignment.
checks: Identity logs arrive in the SIEM
The admin assignment raises an alert

days.topic: Troubleshooting Sign-In: SAML Traces, Token Errors and Conditional Access
subtopics: Token errors such as audience and signature mismatches
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded sign-in failures, a wrong audience, an expired certificate, a Conditional Access block and a deprovisioned user, fix them and write a runbook.
checks: Users sign in after each fix
The runbook covers all four cases

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Workforce Identity for a Mid-Size Company
days.lab_task: Deliver workforce identity for the course company with synced directories, SSO for three apps, passkeys, lifecycle workflows, SCIM, Conditional Access, just-in-time admin access, an access review and identity monitoring.
days.deliverable: Working identity setup with a demo
checks: Users reach all three apps with SSO and strong MFA
Joiners, movers and leavers are handled automatically
Admin access is just in time and monitored

intermediate.summary: For identity engineers and security engineers who design and run identity services. Covers hybrid identity architecture, federation design, OAuth in depth, API authorisation, policy-based access with OPA and Cedar, identity governance with SailPoint, role mining, privileged access with CyberArk, secrets and workload identity, passwordless at scale, identity threat detection and response, Zero Trust access, CIAM at scale, identity for Kubernetes and pipelines, non-human and AI agent identities, identity automation, compliance evidence, Keycloak and SC-300 and Okta exam preparation.
prerequisites: Has configured SSO, MFA and provisioning in Entra ID or Okta
Understands SAML, OAuth and OIDC flows
Comfortable with scripting and REST APIs
outcomes: Design hybrid identity, federation and API authorisation
Run governance, role engineering and privileged access programmes with SailPoint and CyberArk
Secure workloads, pipelines and AI agents with workload identity and least privilege
Detect identity threats, automate identity operations and prepare for SC-300 and Okta exams

days.topic: Hybrid Identity Architecture: Active Directory with Entra Connect and Cloud Sync
subtopics: Password hash sync, pass-through authentication and federation
days.lab_task: Design hybrid identity for the course company, configure Cloud Sync with filtering, choose an authentication method and plan the retirement of AD FS.
days.deliverable: Hybrid identity design with sync configuration
checks: Filtered users sync to Entra ID
The AD FS retirement plan has steps and rollback

days.topic: Federation Design: Multiple Identity Providers, B2B and Partner Access
days.lab_task: Federate with a partner tenant, trust its MFA for one app, route users with home realm discovery and expire inactive guests automatically.
checks: Partner users sign in with their own identity
Partner MFA is accepted only for the chosen app

days.topic: OAuth in Depth: Flows, PKCE, Token Exchange and DPoP
subtopics: Choosing flows for each client type
days.lab_task: Implement refresh token rotation, token exchange between two services and DPoP-bound tokens, and show a stolen token failing.
checks: The downstream service gets a delegated token

days.topic: API Authorisation: Scopes, Claims and Fine-Grained Authorisation
days.lab_task: Design scopes for an orders API, enforce them in the gateway, add resource-level checks in code and test for broken object-level authorisation.
checks: Calls without the right scope are rejected
Users cannot read other users' orders
The test suite covers each permission

days.topic: Policy-Based Access with OPA, Cedar and Authorisation Services
days.lab_task: Write the same document-sharing policy in Rego and Cedar, test both with unit tests and call one from an application as a decision point.
checks: Both policies allow and deny the same cases
The application asks the decision point before access
The choice between OPA and Cedar is justified

days.topic: Identity Governance with SailPoint: Sources, Roles and Certifications
days.lab_task: Connect two sources, build identity profiles, create access profiles and a role, run a certification campaign and add a separation of duties policy.
days.deliverable: Governance setup with a completed campaign
checks: The SoD policy flags conflicting access

days.topic: Role Mining and Role Engineering
days.lab_task: Mine roles from seeded entitlement data for two departments, define business roles with owners and measure how much access the roles cover.
checks: Candidate roles come from entitlement patterns
Business roles have owners and members

days.topic: Privileged Access with CyberArk: Vaulting, Session Isolation and Rotation
days.lab_task: Onboard server and cloud admin accounts into the vault, set rotation, connect through isolated sessions and require a ticket number for access.
checks: Admin accounts are vaulted and rotated
Sessions run through isolation and are recorded
Access needs a valid ticket number

days.topic: Secrets and Workload Identity: Vault, SPIFFE and Cloud Workload Identity
subtopics: HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao basics for identity teams
days.lab_task: Give a service dynamic database credentials from Vault, issue SPIFFE IDs to two workloads and replace a pipeline's stored cloud key with workload identity federation.
checks: The service uses short-lived database credentials
The pipeline has no stored cloud key

days.topic: Passwordless at Scale: Passkey Rollout and Account Recovery
days.lab_task: Plan a passkey rollout for 2,000 users, run a registration campaign for a pilot group, design secure recovery and measure adoption.
days.deliverable: Passkey rollout plan with pilot results
checks: Phases, devices and recovery are planned
Recovery verifies identity without a weak fallback

days.topic: Identity Threat Detection and Response
subtopics: Detecting token theft and session hijacking
Automated response: revoke sessions and reset credentials
days.lab_task: Detect a seeded session hijack and privilege escalation, revoke sessions automatically and investigate the attack path with logs.

days.topic: Zero Trust Access: Device Trust, Continuous Evaluation and ZTNA
tools: Microsoft Entra Private Access or another ZTNA tool
days.lab_task: Require compliant devices for sensitive apps, turn on continuous access evaluation, publish an internal app through ZTNA instead of VPN and test revocation.
days.deliverable: Zero Trust access for sensitive apps
checks: Access ends quickly after user risk changes
The internal app works without VPN

days.topic: CIAM at Scale: Fraud, Bots and Progressive Profiling
subtopics: CIAM architecture for millions of users
days.lab_task: Add bot protection and account takeover detection to customer sign-in, link a social account to an existing account and collect profile data progressively.
checks: Social and email accounts link to one profile

days.topic: Identity for Kubernetes and DevOps Pipelines
days.lab_task: Sign in to a cluster with OIDC groups, scope RBAC by team, give pods cloud access through workload identity and deploy from a pipeline with federated identity.
days.deliverable: Identity setup for a cluster and pipeline
checks: Engineers use corporate identity for kubectl
Teams can manage only their namespaces
The pipeline deploys without stored credentials

days.topic: Non-Human Identities and AI Agent Identities
tools: Microsoft Entra Agent ID or another agent identity feature
days.lab_task: Inventory non-human identities in the lab, register an AI agent identity with scoped delegated access, monitor its actions and assign owners to all machine identities.
days.deliverable: Non-human identity inventory and agent setup
checks: Every machine identity has an owner
The agent can act only within its delegated scopes
Agent actions appear in the logs

days.topic: Identity Automation: Microsoft Graph, Okta Workflows and APIs
days.lab_task: Automate a stale account clean-up with Microsoft Graph and a group membership report with Okta Workflows, with least-privilege automation identities.
checks: Stale accounts are disabled with a report
The membership report arrives on schedule
Automation identities have only needed permissions

days.topic: Identity Compliance: SOX, ISO 27001 and Access Evidence
days.lab_task: Map identity controls for SOX and ISO 27001, collect evidence automatically for one quarter and remediate two seeded audit findings.
days.deliverable: Control map, evidence pack and remediation

days.topic: Keycloak as an Open-Source Identity Provider
days.lab_task: Run Keycloak, create a realm with an OIDC and a SAML client, broker logins from Entra ID, federate LDAP users and customise an authentication flow.
days.deliverable: Keycloak realm with brokering and federation
checks: Users log in through Entra ID

days.topic: SC-300 and Okta Certification Preparation
subtopics: Mapping course days to exam objectives
days.lab_task: Take a timed SC-300 practice set, complete five Okta practice tasks, map misses to course days and write a review plan.
checks: The practice set and tasks are completed
Each miss is mapped to a course day
The review plan covers the weakest objectives

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Governed Identity Platform with SSO, IGA and PAM
days.lab_task: Deliver an identity platform for the course company with hybrid identity, partner federation, API authorisation, SailPoint governance, CyberArk privileged access, workload identity, identity threat detection and automated evidence.
checks: Internal and partner users sign in correctly
Privileged and workload access have no standing secrets

advanced.summary: For identity architects, IAM programme leads and security architects. Covers identity strategy, identity fabric architecture, mergers and divestitures, directory migrations and consolidation, token security, product authorisation with ReBAC, IGA and PAM programme design, securing AI agents, identity resilience, identity attack paths, identity security posture management, digital identity wallets and verifiable credentials, identity metrics, the operating model, vendor strategy, customer identity strategy, third-party and OT access and identity incident response.
prerequisites: Has designed or run identity services for a large organisation
Understands federation, governance and privileged access in depth
Responsible for identity strategy, architecture or risk
outcomes: Set identity strategy and architecture across hybrid and multi-cloud estates
Design governance, privileged access, authorisation and AI agent security programmes
Defend against identity attacks and recover from identity incidents
Lead the identity operating model, vendors and metrics

days.topic: Identity Strategy and Roadmaps for the Enterprise
days.lab_task: Assess the course company's identity maturity, write a target state with principles and a funded two-year roadmap, and present it to the CISO persona.
checks: The roadmap links work to risk reduction

days.topic: Identity Fabric Architecture for Hybrid and Multi-Cloud Estates
days.lab_task: Design an identity fabric for an estate with two identity providers, three clouds and legacy apps, and record the key decisions.
checks: Providers, orchestration and data flows are shown
The design review accepts the architecture with actions

days.topic: Mergers and Divestitures: Identity Integration and Separation
days.lab_task: Plan day-one access for an acquisition with cross-tenant sync, design the tenant consolidation and plan the separation of a divested unit.
checks: Acquired staff reach shared apps on day one
The consolidation plan has phases and rollback
The divested unit's identities are separated cleanly

days.topic: Directory Migrations and Identity Provider Consolidation
days.lab_task: Plan the move of forty apps from an old identity provider to Entra ID or Okta in waves, migrate three apps with tests and plan decommissioning.
checks: Apps are grouped into waves by risk
Three apps move with tested sign-in

days.topic: Token Security: Token Theft, Binding and Continuous Access Evaluation
days.lab_task: Replay a stolen token in the lab, turn on token protection and continuous access evaluation, and show that replay fails and sessions end on risk.
checks: The stolen token works before the controls

days.topic: Authorisation Architecture for Products: ReBAC and Zanzibar-Style Systems
subtopics: Zanzibar-style systems such as OpenFGA and SpiceDB
days.lab_task: Model document sharing with ReBAC, run checks from an application, load-test decision latency and audit decisions.
days.deliverable: ReBAC model with performance and audit results
checks: Sharing rules are expressed as relationships
Decision latency meets the target under load

days.topic: IGA Programme Design: Policies, Risk Scoring and Automation
days.lab_task: Design an IGA programme with policies, risk-scored reviews and auto-approval for low-risk access, and plan onboarding of 200 applications.
checks: Policies cover requests, reviews and SoD
Application onboarding is planned in waves

days.topic: PAM Programme Design: Tiering, Break-Glass and Zero Standing Privilege
days.lab_task: Design a tiered admin model with zero standing privilege, break-glass accounts and privileged workstations, and measure current coverage.
days.deliverable: PAM programme design with coverage baseline
checks: Standing privilege is removed from the design

days.topic: Securing AI Agents: Delegation, Consent and Agent Credentials
days.lab_task: Give an AI agent delegated access to a user's documents with consent, limit it to read scopes through an MCP server and stop it when it behaves oddly.
checks: The agent acts only on behalf of the consenting user
Agent access is revoked on an alert

days.topic: Identity Resilience: Identity Provider Outages, Recovery and Break-Glass
subtopics: Backup and recovery of identity configuration
days.lab_task: Back up identity configuration, run an outage drill using break-glass accounts and restore a deleted Conditional Access policy and app.
checks: Break-glass access works during the drill
The deleted policy and app are restored

days.topic: Identity Attack Paths: Kerberoasting, Golden Tickets and Cloud Escalation
subtopics: Hybrid attack paths into the cloud
days.lab_task: Find attack paths in an authorised lab with an analysis tool, demonstrate Kerberoasting on a weak service account, harden it and confirm the path is closed.
days.deliverable: Attack path analysis and hardening record
checks: Attack paths to admin are listed
The weak service account is cracked in the lab
The path is closed after hardening

days.topic: Identity Security Posture Management
days.lab_task: Run an identity posture assessment, fix the top ten findings with workflows and set a baseline for continuous monitoring.
checks: Drift from the baseline raises alerts

days.topic: Digital Identity Wallets and Verifiable Credentials: eIDAS 2.0 and Beyond
subtopics: The EU Digital Identity Wallet under eIDAS 2.0
Use cases for employees and customers
days.lab_task: Issue an employee credential, verify it with selective disclosure in a sample app and plan how the company will accept EU digital identity wallets.
checks: The credential is issued to the wallet
The app verifies only the needed claims
Wallet acceptance has steps and owners

days.topic: Identity Metrics and Reporting for Leadership
subtopics: Coverage metrics: SSO, MFA, PAM and governance
Efficiency metrics: lifecycle speed and help desk calls
days.lab_task: Define twelve identity metrics with targets, build a leadership dashboard from lab data and present trends and risks.
checks: Leadership questions are answered with data

days.topic: Identity Operating Model: Teams, Services and Service Levels
days.lab_task: Design the identity operating model with teams, a service catalogue, service levels and help desk verification, and report a seeded month of service data.
checks: Service levels are met or explained
Help desk verification resists social engineering

days.topic: Identity Vendor Strategy: Build, Buy and Consolidate
days.lab_task: Compare three identity platform options against requirements and cost, design a proof of concept and write a recommendation with an exit plan.
checks: Total cost of ownership is compared
The recommendation includes an exit plan

days.topic: Customer Identity Strategy: Privacy, Consent and Global Regulations
subtopics: Identity for partners and B2B customers
days.lab_task: Write a customer identity strategy for three regions with consent, residency and security choices, and set CIAM metrics.
checks: Privacy requirements are met per region
Security and friction choices are justified

days.topic: Third-Party and Operational Technology Access
days.lab_task: Give a vendor time-limited, monitored access to an OT system without a shared account, review it after the job and record evidence.
checks: Access is reviewed and removed after the job

days.topic: Incident Response for Identity Compromise
days.lab_task: Run an exercise where an admin account is compromised, contain it, scope the damage, recover trust and write the post-incident review.
checks: Sessions and credentials are revoked quickly
Changes made by the attacker are found

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Identity Programme Design
days.lab_task: Present an enterprise identity programme to a steering committee with the strategy, identity fabric, governance and PAM designs, product authorisation, AI agent security, resilience tests, metrics, operating model and vendor plan.
days.deliverable: Identity programme with evidence and a steering decision
checks: Resilience and security claims have test evidence
Metrics, operating model and vendor plan have owners
